description.value: The Whistle Stop Neighbourhood Pub is a full-service neighbourhood pub in Courtenay on Vancouver Island, offering daily food specials, a broad pub menu running from Sunday brunch through evening entrées, and live music every Friday and Saturday night. A standout feature is their Stonegrill® dining concept, where food is cooked tableside on a superheated volcanic stone. The pub also operates an in-house Beer & Wine Store that prices spirits and beer at or below government liquor store rates.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website fully confirms the business at 2355 Mansfield Dr., Courtenay with phone 250 334 4500, matching OSM tags — contact details are corroborated. The site presents an active, open neighbourhood pub with a food menu, live weekend music, Stonegrill® dining, and an attached Beer & Wine Store; no indication of closure. No mention anywhere on the site of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenity, so all such fields are null; the menu notes daily specials are 'dine in only, no wrap ups, take-outs or to-go' but this is scoped to specials only, leaving takeout for the regular menu unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM address field omits city; website confirms location is Courtenay, BC — address updated to include city.

Events calendar page is displaying what appear to be recurring December 2024 events against a May 2026 calendar header, likely a WordPress calendar plugin display glitch rather than a closure indicator.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible neighbourhood pub with an active website, confirmed contact details, and a full food-and-drink operation in Courtenay — a useful stop for touring cyclists.

Takeout.detail: Regular menu items appear available for takeout; however the website explicitly states daily specials are 'dine in only — no wrap ups, take-outs or to-go.'

wow_evidence: Stonegrill® dining concept, where food is cooked tableside on a superheated volcanic stone
